title: Concept: Symfony VarDumper output disclosed in a response
description: Symfony VarDumper prints the complete value graph of the object it receives, including private properties, request attributes and environment values. A dump left in a production response therefore discloses data the page never intended to render, often including credentials held in configuration objects.
applicability: Responses generated by a Symfony application that still contains a dump or dd() call.
risk: The caller reads configuration values, request attributes and object internals that the endpoint does not otherwise expose, which can include credentials and internal host names.
